title: An ICE officer has been charged after striking a man with a car in Houston - CNN
description: A U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer accused of intentionally ramming his car into a Mexican construction worker in Houston was charged Friday with aggravated assault with a deadly weapon, prosecutors said.

title: Pope Leo becomes first pontiff to vote in U.S. election - The Washington Post
description: The Vatican announcement comes as President Donald Trump has sought to cast doubt on mail-in voting.

title: Rose-colored meteorite found in the Sahara Desert turns out to be 4.1 billion-year-old piece of Mars - CBS News
description: A meteorite found in the Sahara Desert has been determined to be 4.1 billion years old and from Mars.

title: Trump uncancels weekend rallies in Iowa and Kansas with Senate control at stake - NBC News
